summary: Sow Good Inc. filed an Item 8.01 8-K on October 13, 2026, announcing that its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders is expected on December 17, 2026, a change of more than 30 days from the prior-year anniversary, triggering Rule 14a-5(f) disclosure. Because of the date shift, the company reset the deadline for stockholder proposals and director nominations, including Rule 14a-8 submissions, to close of business October 23, 2026. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics were disclosed, and the filing represents a routine meeting-notice and proxy-deadline update, not a special situation.
